purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: Federal Agency AI Plans and Infrastructure
question: How do the September 29 Super Intelligence and America.gov executive orders change federal AI terminology and service-delivery architecture, and which authority, implementation, operation and effect gates remain open?
bluf: The September 29 actions form a two-order stack. The first directs the executive branch to use Super Intelligence or SI in non-statutory documents, but imports the existing statutory AI definition and establishes no superhuman-capability threshold. The second establishes America.gov as a GSA-led front door integrating Login.gov and existing agency interfaces while preserving originating-agency records, authority and adjudication. White House texts are confirmed; Federal Register numbers, the 60-day legislative proposal, the 90-day OMB memorandum, covered-service integrations, transactions and effects remain distinct open receipts. The underlying eleven-entity census remains frozen at August 23.
evidence_cutoff_note: September 29 executive-order texts, fact sheets and current America.gov control surfaces are included. Federal Register numbers and publication objects were unavailable at cutoff. The overall proposal-to-operation layer remains current through September 28; the eleven-entity inventory and supplier census remain frozen through August 23.
use_note: Internal recall only. Use the September 28 proposal map for the national transition and the August 23 ledgers for entity use cases and suppliers. Preserve blueprint, recommendation, public review, signed direction, operative policy, funding, implementation, operation, effect and remedy as separate states. The evidence supports a distributed translation-and-gate layer, not one central AI platform, comprehensive preemption, completed physical buildout or a general notice, explanation, appeal and correction regime.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
